links.outcome: Agreement of AI app energy intake estimates with doubly labelled water in free-living use
links.effect: SNAQ underestimated energy intake by 25% (2187 ± 1401 vs 3004 ± 481 kcal/day; p = 0.01). Limits of agreement were -3707 to 2073 kcal/day and within-subject ICC was 0.00.
links.quote: Despite its advanced AI architecture, SNAQ showed poor accuracy and reproducibility in free-living adults with obesity.

screen.reason: Empirical clinical validation of an AI-powered computer vision app for dietary assessment in female patients with obesity against doubly labelled water.
